Card Q&A.q: When I digivolved into this card, my opponent had 3 or less cards in their hand. Do I still gain memory from the [When Digivolving] effect?

Card Q&A.a: If you have a Digimon with this effect, your opponent's Digimon can't block against its attacks.
Card Q&A.q: What exactly does "this Digimon is unblockable" mean?

Card Q&A.a: No. Attacking suspended Digimon isn't blocking, so you can attack them.
Card Q&A.q: Does "this Digimon is unblockable" mean this Digimon can't attack my opponent's suspended Digimon?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Gain 1 memory for every 4 cards in your opponent's hand.
